body.name: \(\mathfrak M_{p,m}^{\mathrm{CA}}\)
body.construction: \(\mathfrak M_{p,m}^{\mathrm{CA}}\) consists of tuples \((P,B^0,\varepsilon,\Gamma,\pi_0)\) such that \((P,B^0,\varepsilon,\pi_0)\in\mathfrak M_{p,m}^{\mathrm{pub}}\), \(\Gamma_j=\operatorname{Cov}_P((\varepsilon_j^{(a)})_{a\in M})\) for every \(j\in V\), and \(\texttt{ass:component-aligned-disturbances}\) and \(\texttt{ass:disturbance-positive-definiteness}\) hold.  Thus \(\mathfrak M_{p,m}^{\mathrm{CA}}\) is the component-aligned subclass; no Gaussianity restriction is imposed on its generating law.
